# agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin keeps prompt headers steady and avoids repeated reads of unchanged files. Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Complements Agent Skills & audits Skills prefix tax**: Works orthogonally alongside domain Agent Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex — Skills guide task workflows while `agy-dart` handles low-level read guards, log filtering, and KV-cache hygiene underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter overhead and progressive-disclosure structure across installed skills. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.2 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default for chats without an override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.2 - **Agent Skills progressive disclosure & prefix-tax audit**: Restructured `skills/agy-dart/` with on-demand `examples/` (`ctx_trace_summary.py`, `filters.json`) and `references/error-playbook.md` synced cleanly across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter tax and progressive-disclosure hygiene, and separated on-demand skill assets in `prefix:budget`. - **Scoped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` check routing**: Guided built-in minimal agents to prefer `run_checks` for short checks (keeping `run_command` for `>60s` or async tasks) so command outputs stay within 8.8 KB without losing `inheritMcp: false` / `inheritCustomizations: false` isolation. - **Test & packaging hardening**: Isolated `AGY_DART_CONFIG_PATH` in `v1.2-persist-prefix.test.mjs` so local `~/.agy-dart/config.json` overrides (such as `stablePrefixOnly: true`) never interfere with unit tests, and excluded Python bytecode artifacts (`__pycache__`, `*.py[cod]`) from Git and package manifests. ### v1.7.1 - **Accurate "Guard Saved" accounting for `agy-dart_fast` tools**: `read_slices`, `run_checks`, and `batch_search` now record strictly non-inflated byte savings (only when raw input/output genuinely exceeds returned bytes) and attribute anonymous shared MCP calls cleanly to the active conversation without cross-session stealing. - **Expanded Windows / PowerShell CLI filtering**: `cli-filter` now recognizes leading package-manager flags (`npm --prefix`, `pnpm -C`, `yarn --cwd`, etc.) and safe `--` argument/path separators while preserving cross-shell safety guards. - **Complete MCP receipt claiming & subagent rollup**: Extended receipt claiming to `ctx_index` and `ctx_batch` alongside `ctx_execute`, synced `sources`/`chunks` ownership (`schema v155` + `idx_sources_origin_session`), and unified `rootSessionId` rollup so subagent savings roll up into parent conversation stats without double-counting. ### v1.7.0 - **Compact signature outlines & inline read-guard outlines**: Added compact function-signature outlines and inline line-number outlines when a large un-ranged file read is intercepted on first blind read. - **Multi-host CLI (`bin/agy-dart.mjs`) & scoped subagents**: Added `agy-dart` CLI with `--target claude|codex`, `outline`, `session`, and `compare` commands, shipped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` role definitions, and hardened workspace isolation & Node.js 22.16+ / 24+ SQLite FTS5 checks. ### v1.6.0 - **4 core fast tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional multi-file edit drops**: Batch search, outlines, multi-file edits, and concurrent checks now preload directly instead of going through the wrapper tool that occasionally emptied multi-file edit arrays; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save initial context (switchable via `tool-loading`). - **Fixed automatic cache keepalive & skipped all subagents**: Cleared legacy global-off state conflicts from old panel processes, added duplicate-send locks, and auto-restarts the background panel after plugin updates; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — no longer trigger keepalives or take over the top keepalive bar. - **Direct file reads for subagents, plugin-folder write protection**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files directly without red-text blocks; calls missing a project path that land inside the installed plugin folder are blocked so the plugin never searches or edits its own files. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell install commands. - Cross-platform hook launcher; unused quota from short checks shifts to long error traces; read-only Git sandboxing against external `.git/config` hooks; clean Windows exit, preserved `rules/*.local.md` on upgrade, plus `SECURITY.md` and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added code outlines for multi-thousand-line `.html` / `.astro` and `.dart` files; fixed Windows Python / PowerShell encoding garbling and paused panel refreshes while hidden. ### v1.5.1 - Filled in untranslated strings in Chinese UI mode; tuned post-edit file-limit suggestions. ### v1.5.0 - **Read actual model cache expiry time**: Reads the active model's real cache lifetime (such as 5m or 15m) from recent usage and carries it into new chats. - Added optional 1-minute cache-expiry desktop reminder and CLI keepalive cost simulation. ### v1.4.0 - **Hang detection & rescue summary**: Flags chats stuck spinning with zero output (ignoring long builds and laptop sleep), points to the stalled step in the panel, and prepares a one-click progress summary (modified files, last command, current step) to continue in a new chat. ### v1.3.1 - Allow immediate file re-reads right after `/compact`; skip dedup prompts on slices under 4 KB; preserve mid-log error lines in long failure outputs. ### v1.3.0 - **Tiered file-read limits**: Raised direct reads to 45 KB (800 lines) for normal code and 128 KB for `.patch` files while keeping noisy logs at 16 KB; second-try reads pass through so patch reviews and subagents don't stall. - Added `.patch` file outlines and kept context lines when trimming `git diff`. ### v1.2.2 - **Uninterrupted long tasks**: Removed mid-task `/compact` prompts and routed >60s builds, tests, and background servers straight to Antigravity's native background runner. - Blocked `.env` reads and fixed 42 Windows shell, isolation, and orphan-process issues. ### v1.2.1 - Automatic rollback on failed multi-file edits and 76 path/argument stability fixes. ### v1.2.0 - Unified settings in `~/.agy-dart/config.json`; added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills --workspace . # Audit Skills Turn-0 frontmatter tax & progressive disclosure npm run cache:simulate ``` --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). Incorporates and adapts MIT-licensed code from [INK-Q/agy-fast](https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast) and [Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode); full third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## v1.7 CLI Install for Antigravity by default. Select Claude Code or Codex explicitly with `--target claude|codex`. Use `outline ` for a compact signature map and `session ` or `compare ` for transcript usage. For Claude Code and Codex, the installer keeps hashes and undo metadata in `~/.agy-dart/-install.json` to restore the plugin's configuration changes. Reinstalling replaces an older full-config record. Uninstalling removes that host's record. ```sh git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart node bin/agy-dart.mjs install node bin/agy-dart.mjs doctor ```

# agy-dart **Google Antigravity 插件 — 省 token · 优化缓存命中 · 自动保持缓存温度 · 优化上下文额度 · 抢救崩掉的会话** 不用额外装依赖 · 装好自动在后台工作 · 自带右侧面板 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) 或 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) 简体中文 · [English](README.md) · [怎么安装](#怎么安装) · [更新日志](#更新日志) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md) · [开源致谢](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## 这个 Google Antigravity 插件是干什么的？ `agy-dart` 是专为 **Google Antigravity** 打造的性能、缓存与上下文管理插件（同时支持通过 `--target` 安装到 Claude Code 与 Codex）：减少重复读取和过长的工具输出，查看缓存用量，会话占满上下文或卡住时可以把进度带到新对话。 装好之后在后台自动生效，不用记新命令，平时照常打字聊天就行： ### 1. 整合动作 AI 要搜好几个词时一次同时搜完，要改多个文件时一次改完并顺手跑完测试，少跑好几轮重复带上下文的请求。 ### 2. 挡住废话 跑一次测试吐出 3000 行日志，插件只挑关键那几句给 AI（比如第 42 行报错，其余 199 个通过），完整原文存进本地备查。遇到几千行的大代码文件，先拉目录再读要改的那几十行。 ### 3. 缓存监测与按需续温 插件保持提示前缀稳定，减少短时间内重复读取未修改的文件。自动续温和缓存到期桌面提醒默认关闭。首次开启续温时，每段对话最多自动请求 1 次，发新消息后重新计数。次数可在面板里调整。 ### 4. 右侧面板与崩溃/卡死抢救 右侧边栏面板直接显示：上下文还有多少、缓存还剩几分钟过期、挡掉了多少废话。 多开项目窗口时，哪个后台窗口上下文快满了，或者一直转圈不出字，右下角会弹窗标明是哪个窗口、哪段对话，点一下弹窗直接切过去。会话真因为爆上下文崩掉或卡死时，在面板点一下复制当前进度摘要，贴到新对话接着往下做。 ### 其他内置功能 1. **压缩对话（`/compact`）后恢复上下文线索**：后台记录本轮改过哪些文件、最近一次测试或打包过没过、存过哪些参考资料。跑完 `/compact` 后 AI 可以直接调出这份记录接着做。 2. **长文档与网页存本地检索**：几万字的开发文档或网页可以先按章节存进本地数据库，后面用到哪段按关键词搜哪段。 3. **大日志与大表格先在本地跑脚本筛选**：遇到几十 MB 的日志、CSV 或几万行 JSON，AI 可以在本地沙盒跑几行脚本先做统计（比如筛出报错最多的 5 个接口），只把算出来的结果发回对话；大 JSON 还会自动摘出报错的异常条。 4. **新对话自动附带目录结构**：刚开对话时自动给出一份精简的项目目录、脚本和核心文件清单。 5. **死循环提示**：AI 连续出现「改代码 → 报错 → 改回去 → 又报错」或反复调同一个工具没进展时，在聊天界面弹一行只给用户看的提示（不塞进模型上下文）。 6. **密钥打码、敏感文件与 Git 沙盒防护**：日志或网页里的 API Key、口令自动打码；可拦截 AI 误读 `.env` 等配置文件，并封堵陌生仓库 `.git/config` 挂载外部命令的入口。 7. **单次返回卡在 8.8 KB 以内（智能匀配额）**：Antigravity 工具单次返回超过约 10 KB 会自动落成临时文件让 AI 多读一轮；插件把返回内容控制在 8.8 KB 内，并自动把短检查省下的空间让给真正报错的长堆栈。 8. **面板细分统计与离线测算**：右侧面板能查看上下文花在读文件、终端输出还是子智能体上，以及最近 15 轮缓存命中走势和失效原因；可选开启大文件修改后只读改动行（默认关闭）；命令行支持拿历史记录测算缓存命中与自动续期账本。 9. **与 Agent Skills 生态正交互补，支持全环境 Skills 体检**：可与 Antigravity / Claude Code / Codex 各类业务 Skill 无缝叠加——业务 Skill 负责工作流编排，插件在底层兜底拦截盲读大文件、裁剪刷屏输出并守护缓存；运行 `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` 可一键审计所有已安装 Skills 的 Turn-0 前缀税与渐进式披露结构。 > Antigravity 官方更新很勤，可以点一下右上角 **Star** 方便跟进后续兼容更新。 --- ## 怎么安装 使用 **Node.js 22.x 的 22.16.0 及以上版本，或 Node.js 24 及以上版本**。安装器会检查内置 SQLite 是否支持 FTS5 及其 trigram 分词器。插件只使用内置模块。 ### 方法一：终端一行命令直装（免手动克隆） **Windows（PowerShell）：** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux：** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.sh | sh ``` ### 方法二：直接发给 Antigravity 装 复制这句发给 Antigravity： ```text 请将 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git 的 v1.7.2 标签克隆到临时目录，运行其中的 scripts/install.mjs install 完成全局安装并跑 doctor 自检（Windows 如未安装 rg 请同时传 --install-rg）。 ``` ### 方法三：克隆仓库自定义安装 ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell（加 -InstallRg 可顺手自动安装快速搜索工具 rg） .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **其他命令：** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # 全局安装（若本机存在 GEMINI_HOME 或 T3 ACP 目录会自动同步） node scripts/install.mjs install --project /项目路径 # 只装到单个项目 node scripts/install.mjs doctor # 检查安装状态 node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # 卸载 ``` 装完重启或刷新一下 Antigravity 窗口，新开对话生效。升级重装时会自动保留插件目录下你自建的 `rules/*.local.md`。以前单独装过 `agy-fast` 或 `antigravity-plugin-context-mode` 的话，去插件列表关掉旧的。 索引内容和用量记录默认保存在本机 `~/.agy-dart/context.db`，卸载后会保留。卸载前可调用 `ctx_purge` 清理当前对话的索引。宿主未提供会话 ID 时，此操作会清理已确认工作区的匿名数据。如需清理所有项目的索引和历史记录，可用 `scope: "all"` 调用 `ctx_purge`。 全局卸载也会移除安装器有记录的 Gemini/T3 同步副本。遇到无法确认归属的旧副本时，安装器会列出路径和单独卸载该副本的命令。 --- ## 设置调节 自动加热默认关闭。需要时，在右侧 **agy-dart Context** 面板为当前窗口打开“自动续温”。“全局加热”控制所有跟随全局设置的窗口。关闭当前窗口的自动续温后，缓存即将过期和续温次数用尽都不会弹出桌面提醒。任务卡死弹窗也默认关闭，可在面板中单独开启。每次加热都会请求模型回复 `OK` 并产生输入用量，缓存未命中时可能重新处理整段历史。面板也可设置桌面提醒、暂停保护、清理旧记录和调整文件大小限制。 也可以用命令切拦截档位与工具加载方式： ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # 默认：普通代码 45 KB、补丁 128 KB 内直读，大日志超 16 KB 拦截 node scripts/install.mjs # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · English · [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin keeps prompt headers steady and avoids repeated reads of unchanged files. Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Complements Agent Skills & audits Skills prefix tax**: Works orthogonally alongside domain Agent Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex — Skills guide task workflows while `agy-dart` handles low-level read guards, log filtering, and KV-cache hygiene underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter overhead and progressive-disclosure structure across installed skills. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.2/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.2 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default for chats without an override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.2 - **Agent Skills progressive disclosure & prefix-tax audit**: Restructured `skills/agy-dart/` with on-demand `examples/` (`ctx_trace_summary.py`, `filters.json`) and `references/error-playbook.md` synced cleanly across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter tax and progressive-disclosure hygiene, and separated on-demand skill assets in `prefix:budget`. - **Scoped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` check routing**: Guided built-in minimal agents to prefer `run_checks` for short checks (keeping `run_command` for `>60s` or async tasks) so command outputs stay within 8.8 KB without losing `inheritMcp: false` / `inheritCustomizations: false` isolation. - **Test & packaging hardening**: Isolated `AGY_DART_CONFIG_PATH` in `v1.2-persist-prefix.test.mjs` so local `~/.agy-dart/config.json` overrides (such as `stablePrefixOnly: true`) never interfere with unit tests, and excluded Python bytecode artifacts (`__pycache__`, `*.py[cod]`) from Git and package manifests. ### v1.7.1 - **Accurate "Guard Saved" accounting for `agy-dart_fast` tools**: `read_slices`, `run_checks`, and `batch_search` now record strictly non-inflated byte savings (only when raw input/output genuinely exceeds returned bytes) and attribute anonymous shared MCP calls cleanly to the active conversation without cross-session stealing. - **Expanded Windows / PowerShell CLI filtering**: `cli-filter` now recognizes leading package-manager flags (`npm --prefix`, `pnpm -C`, `yarn --cwd`, etc.) and safe `--` argument/path separators while preserving cross-shell safety guards. - **Complete MCP receipt claiming & subagent rollup**: Extended receipt claiming to `ctx_index` and `ctx_batch` alongside `ctx_execute`, synced `sources`/`chunks` ownership (`schema v155` + `idx_sources_origin_session`), and unified `rootSessionId` rollup so subagent savings roll up into parent conversation stats without double-counting. ### v1.7.0 - **Compact signature outlines & inline read-guard outlines**: Added compact function-signature outlines and inline line-number outlines when a large un-ranged file read is intercepted on first blind read. - **Multi-host CLI (`bin/agy-dart.mjs`) & scoped subagents**: Added `agy-dart` CLI with `--target claude|codex`, `outline`, `session`, and `compare` commands, shipped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` role definitions, and hardened workspace isolation & Node.js 22.16+ / 24+ SQLite FTS5 checks. ### v1.6.0 - **4 core fast tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional multi-file edit drops**: Batch search, outlines, multi-file edits, and concurrent checks now preload directly instead of going through the wrapper tool that occasionally emptied multi-file edit arrays; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save initial context (switchable via `tool-loading`). - **Fixed automatic cache keepalive & skipped all subagents**: Cleared legacy global-off state conflicts from old panel processes, added duplicate-send locks, and auto-restarts the background panel after plugin updates; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — no longer trigger keepalives or take over the top keepalive bar. - **Direct file reads for subagents, plugin-folder write protection**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files directly without red-text blocks; calls missing a project path that land inside the installed plugin folder are blocked so the plugin never searches or edits its own files. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell install commands. - Cross-platform hook launcher; unused quota from short checks shifts to long error traces; read-only Git sandboxing against external `.git/config` hooks; clean Windows exit, preserved `rules/*.local.md` on upgrade, plus `SECURITY.md` and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. -
